_comment: Config for nobsdash.com/work — the private-AI-server setup service. Edit this file only; the page reads it at load. An empty paymentLink turns the buy button into a quote request instead of a dead checkout.

_howToEnable.paymentLink: Square Dashboard → Online → Payment Links → create a link for the setup service, then paste the https://square.link/... URL here
_howToEnable.contactEmail: The address you want inquiries sent to. Leave empty to fall back to the GitHub profile link.
_howToEnable.acceptingWork: Set false when you are booked; the page then says so plainly instead of taking money you cannot deliver against.
